item.title: Yemen’s Ansarullah condemns ‘unjust’ verdicts against scholars in Bahrain
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Yemen's Ansarullah movement has denounced the Bahraini government for its rulings against religious scholars in that country, describing the verdicts as unjust and aimed at bringing the Bahraini nation to its knees.

item.title: Iran’s UN Mission: Accusations regarding dams and dirty bomb are disinformation campaign
item.description: New York, IRNA – The Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations dismissed The New York Times’ report regarding Iran’s dams, as well as CNN’s fabricated narrative concerning allegations of a dirty bomb, as baseless—characterizing them as part of a campaign of disinformation and the dissemination of falsehoods.

item.title: Iran’s Armed Forces more prepared than ever to defend country: IRGC deputy commander
